hero.kicker: Your adaptive coach · Triathlon · Run · Bike · Any endurance sport
hero.h1:
Tell us your race.
We build the plan.
hero.lede: Triple Peaks is an adaptive coach that builds your training plan and adjusts it every week as life gets in the way. Built for the rest of us. People who train around a job and a family.
hero.alt_note: Best on iPhone. The coach lives in the app.
problem.h2: A real coach used to cost a real coach.
problem.lede: Your watch suggests workouts, but it doesn't know your race, your week, or your bad night's sleep. Other AI coaches assume you already train like a pro. Human coaches start at €150 a month. So most amateurs train off feel.
problem.c1.p: Auto-suggestions with no goal, no race day, and no idea what your week looks like.
problem.c2.p: Designed for athletes who already know their FTP and zones.
problem.c3.p: Months of commitment, replies within a day, during office hours. Worth it, if you can afford it and get a spot.
problem.c4.h4: A few dollars a month. For everyone.
problem.c4.p: Adapts in seconds, any hour. No waitlist, no lock-in. Your first plan lands tonight.
how.s1.h3: A plan, ready before your coffee.
how.s1.p: Race, date, days you can train, hours you've got. First week lands on your phone before the kettle boils.
how.s1.caption: Onboarding · 4 questions, no quiz
how.s1.alt: Triple Peaks weekly plan view with calendar and a Tempo Intervals run card
how.s2.p: One plain-English sentence before each session: why this pace, why today, what it's building. You'll start to get it.
how.s2.caption: Sunday's long run · 12 km, built step by step
how.s2.alt: Structured workout view showing warm-up, intervals, and cool-down with target paces
how.s3.h3: Next week adapts to last week.
how.s3.p: Skipped Tuesday, slept badly Thursday, ran 12K on a hilly trip. The plan you wake up to on Monday already knows.
how.s3.caption: Weekly reshuffle · 3 sessions moved
how.s3.alt: AI coach chat reshuffling the week's sessions and explaining the change
founder.h2: The person who built it used it to finish an Ironman.
founder.lede: Training where every week builds on the last is how coached athletes improve. Triple Peaks puts that structure in your pocket, and its first user was the person who built it.
founder.quote: “I built this for myself. Nine months later I finished an Ironman, and I hadn't trained much more than the year before that. What actually changed was training all three sports instead of just the one I liked, fixing my run and swim, and following a plan instead of making it up week to week.”
founder.name: Lukas
founder.role: Founder of Triple Peaks · Ironman finisher
versus.lede: Without a plan, every Monday is a fresh decision. With one that adapts, every session has a reason. Three common moments:
versus.r1.q: Slept 5 hours. Tomorrow is a hard run.
versus.r1.tp: The hard run moves to Wednesday. Today: 30 easy minutes. No guilt, no lost week.
versus.r1.them: Push through and feel rough all week, or skip and feel guilty.
versus.r2.q: 42 days to Berlin. Am I on pace for sub-1:55?
versus.r2.tp: Yes, your last three long runs were right on goal pace, and you're still getting faster.
versus.r2.them: Last Sunday's long run felt OK. Beyond that, no idea.
versus.r3.q: Berlin is Sunday. How much should I ease off this week?
versus.r3.tp: This week is lighter on purpose, plus two short race-pace efforts Thursday, so you arrive fresh, not flat.
versus.r3.them: Read six Reddit threads. Skip Friday. Sleep badly Saturday.
cta.p: From a few dollars a month. Free for two weeks. No card. Cancel any time.
footer.tagline: A coach in your pocket, for the rest of us.

features.meta.title: Features · Triple Peaks
features.meta.description: Adaptive weekly plans, workout analysis, structured intervals, an AI coach chat, Strava sync, and race-day periodization for endurance athletes.
features.ph.h1: One coach. Six ways it shows up for you.
features.ph.p: From the weekly plan to race week, here's what Triple Peaks actually does, screen by screen.
features.f1.h2: A plan for the week you're actually having.
features.f1.p: Every Monday, Triple Peaks rebuilds your week around your current form, how last week actually went, and the hours you really have, balancing swim, bike, and run so the hard days don't collide.
features.f1.li1: Easy days stay easy, hard days earn the gains. The mix every good coach prescribes.
features.f1.li2: Volume scaled to the time you've got, with an honest week-over-week score.
features.f1.alt: Weekly plan view with calendar and a completed Tempo Intervals run card
features.f2.h2: Every workout and every week, reviewed, not just recorded.
features.f2.p: When a session ends, Triple Peaks scores it against the plan: how you paced it, how hard it really was, what it means for tomorrow. Then every Sunday it sums the whole week up in plain English: what you completed, how it went, and what it sets up next.
features.f2.li1: A per-workout execution score: Excellent, Good, On Track, or Needs Improvement.
features.f2.li2: A weekly recap that names the sessions that actually moved you forward.
features.f2.alt: Activity Insights screen showing execution quality score of 90 for a progressive long run
features.f3.h2: Every detail, planned interval by interval.
features.f3.p: Key sessions come fully built: warm-up, main set, cool-down. Each step has its own target pace, power, or heart rate. Send it to your Apple Watch and just follow along, no squinting at a plan mid-interval.
features.f3.li1: Every step has a target: pace, power, or heart-rate zone.
features.f3.li2: Push to Apple Watch for guided, step-by-step execution.
features.f3.alt: Structured workout view of a long run with warm-up, progressive intervals, and cool-down pace targets
features.f4.h2: Ask your coach anything, with context.
features.f4.p: It already knows your plan, your last four weeks, and your check-ins. Ask it to reshuffle the week, swap a session, or pressure-test your race plan, and get a straight answer, not a hedge.
features.f4.li1: Sees your full picture: fitness, fatigue, sleep, and recent sessions.
features.f4.li2: Suggests changes you can apply to your plan in one tap.
features.f4.alt: AI Coach chat with plan adjustments and balance analysis
features.f5.h2: From 5K to Ironman, built backwards from race day.
features.f5.p: Set your goal race and Triple Peaks maps the whole season: Base, Build, Peak, then an easier run-in to race day, with the right build-up and race-specific work for your distance.
features.f5.li1: The full season at a glance, with weeks-to-go and your current phase.
features.f5.li2: Tuned to your race: Sprint, Olympic, 70.3, Ironman, marathon, or ultra.
features.f5.alt: Training phases timeline for a triathlon goal with Base completed and Build as the current phase
features.f6.c1.p: Connect once. Runs, rides, swims, and multi-sport all flow in automatically: GPS, heart rate, pace, and power, with no duplicates.
features.f6.c2.p: Tap Good, Tired, or Unwell. Add a sleep score 1–5 and a note. Your coach factors it in before today's recommendations.
features.cta.h2: Try the full coach, free for two weeks.
features.cta.p: No card, no waitlist. Your first plan lands tonight.
support.meta.title: Support · Triple Peaks
support.meta.description: Help and support for Triple Peaks: FAQs, Strava connection, account, and data.
support.ph.h1: We're here to help you keep training.
support.ph.p: Answers to common questions, plus a direct line when you need one.
support.contact.h2: Drop us a line. We read every email.
support.contact.p: Bug, billing question, or feature idea. We typically reply within 24 hours on business days.
support.contact.note: For account deletion, billing issues, or anything you'd rather not ask in the app.
support.q1.body: Open the Triple Peaks app and go to Settings. Tap Connect Strava and authorize access. Your rides, runs, and swims will start syncing automatically, including GPS, heart rate, and power.
support.q2.body: To disconnect, revoke Triple Peaks' access in your Strava settings under "My Apps". Your synced data in Triple Peaks stays until you delete your account.
support.q3.body: Not officially yet. The iPhone app is on the App Store, and the Android app is in closed beta. Want in? Email triplepeaks@online.de and we'll send you a beta invite. In the meantime, the web app works on any device.
support.q4.summary: How do I manage my subscription?
support.q4.body: Subscriptions are managed through the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android). Open your device's subscription settings to change or cancel your plan. Your training history stays safe either way.
support.q5.summary: How do I delete my account?
support.q5.body: Open Settings in the app and select Delete Account. Your account and data are removed from the app, and clear from our backups over time. You can also email triplepeaks@online.de to request deletion directly.
support.q6.body: Check that your Strava connection is active in Settings. Tap Sync Profile under the Strava section to trigger a manual sync. If it still fails, revoke access in Strava's app settings and reconnect from the Triple Peaks app. If the issue persists, email us and we'll dig in.
support.q7.summary: Do you use AI, and what happens to my data?
support.q7.body: Yes. AI coaching is the core of the app. To build your plans, analyses, and chat replies, we send your training and performance data to an AI provider. Before we send it, we remove direct identifiers like your name and email, so the provider sees your training data rather than who you are. You agree to this when you sign up, and you can turn AI features off or delete your account at any time. See our Privacy Policy for the details.
support.q8.body: We take reasonable care: connections are encrypted, access is limited to what's needed to run the app, and we never sell your data. No app can promise perfect security, but we keep the moving parts few and use established providers. Full details live in our Privacy Policy.
